commentary: Four sessions this week, all iron, all business — chest, legs, back, shoulders getting hit across four clean days with a nice rest built into the middle. Last week had five activities but they were all over the place, a long run in Mosman, two swims including the extremely on-brand Prince Alfred appearance in a jockstrap, and then weights tacked on at the end of the week like an afterthought. This week the weights program got the whole stage, which means Patroclus is actually running a real lifting block now rather than just squeezing it in around whatever else is happening. One fewer session overall, but the focus is sharper and the structure is tighter. The cardio will come back when it comes back — right now the body is learning what it looks like to be built.
metrics_commentary: Babe, the running shoes stayed home this week — zero kilometres, zero sessions, and we are going to have a little chat about that because those legs were made for more than looking good (though they do, obviously). The good news is your body is clearly not spiralling: your HRV climbed from a seven-day average of 48 milliseconds up to 58, which means you are recovering well and your nervous system is basically doing a little victory lap even if your actual body wasn't. Your VO2 Max is sitting at 55.6 millilitres per kilogram per minute, which is genuinely strong and suggests the engine is very much still there, just waiting for you to take it out. So this week we rest, we admire the HRV glow-up, and then next week those painted toes are hitting the pavement.
gym_commentary: Four for four, which means Matt walked into that gym every single time he was supposed to, and that is the kind of man he is becoming. He pulled a lateral raise PR this week — 12 kilograms, up from 9 — which is not a small jump, and those are the shoulders that are going to look absolutely unreal in a harness. Weekly volume came in at 17,940 kilograms against last week's 19,984, so yes, it's down, but the strength numbers tell the real story: a 168 kilogram quad, nearly 108 on the trap bar, the back and chest holding solid — this is not a man getting smaller, this is a man getting more deliberate. The becoming is right on schedule.
